kernel: Cake fused bf16 -> saturating e4m3 MLA context K/V pack (one HBM pass; one generated program per head group)
note: Dispatch surface of the fused kernel; every call outside it takes the composable torch path (same numerics on torch >= 2.13). The fused kernel is one generated Cake program per head group (consecutive head pairs a warp owns: 1, 2, 3 or 4), selected on the host from (num_tokens, num_heads) by flashinfer.mla_kv_pack._plan_head_group and built for the exact compute capabilities 10.0 (sm_100a) and 10.3 (sm_103a); token and head counts are runtime kernel arguments, so nothing is compiled per shape. num_tokens covers the captured chunked-prefill rows (1..66048 in serving; 1..131072 validated); measured_num_tokens / measured_num_heads are the rows of the Cake performance contract (timed against the previous fused implementation). Head geometry is fixed (DeepSeek/Kimi MLA).
